articles.summary: npm, Anthropic, PlanetScale and now Trigger.dev all support OIDC workload identity. We explain what it is, who issues the token, and how a service checks it.
articles.title: How OIDC workload identity works

articles.summary: Lessons from building Trigger.dev's OIDC issuer: proving which job is asking, designing the subject, giving each organization its own issuer URL, and rotating keys without breaking verifiers.
articles.title: Some things to consider when building an OIDC issuer

articles.summary: An attacker gained unauthorized access to environment variables for a subset of organizations. We've blocked the exploit and emailed all impacted account owners with steps to mitigate.
articles.title: Security Disclosure: Sunday November 1st

articles.summary: On November 1, 2026, we became aware of a security incident which impacted some of our customers. This included unauthorized access to environment variables.
articles.title: Security incident report: Sunday November 1st
